PROTECTION

OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:  1. Region is North Buton Regency.

2. Regional Government is the Government of North Buton Regency.  3. Regent is the Regent of North Buton.
4-

4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of North Buton Regency.
5. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
6. Woman is a person who has female genitalia, can experience menstruation, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and includes persons who are legally recognized as Women.
7. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including children in the womb who become victims of violence as well as children in conflict with the law.
8. Violence is any act against a person that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
9. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
10. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
11. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, serious injury or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
12. Psychological Violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feeling of helplessness or severe psychological suffering to a person.
13. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of forced sexual intercourse, sexual abuse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural and/or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
5-

14. Exploitation is an action with or without the consent of the victim which includes but is not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
15. Victim is a woman and child who experiences physical suffering, psychological suffering, sexual suffering, either directly or indirectly resulting from acts of violence.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
18. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by Professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
21. Repatriation is an effort to return women and children victims of violence to the family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.
22. Rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological, and social conditions so that they can carry out their roles again properly both in the family and in society.
23. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with the family, community, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
24. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
6-

25. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, Safe House, Child Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter, etc.
26. Minimum Service Standards hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.
27. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children victims of violence.
28. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 18

(I) PPT in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with Sub-district PPT, and competent parties in making efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children.

2. Further provisions regarding the mechanism for implementing prevention duties as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 27

( 1) The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, customary institutions or non-governmental organizations and universities that implement protection for women and children victims of violence.

2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.
17-

Article 12

The obligations of the family and Parents as referred to in Article 9 letter c, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect Women and Children as part of family members.
11-

Article 13

1. In order to provide services and protection to Women and Children from violence, the Regional Government establishes PPT as an integrated service center for Women and Children victims of violence.
2. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1), consists of elements from the Health Office, Education Office, Youth and Sports Office, Social Office, Cooperatives, SMEs and Manpower Office, Industry and Trade Office, Population and Civil Registration Office, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Office, Community and Village Empowerment Office, Civil Service Police Unit, Regional General Hospital, Police Resort, Kulisusu Palace Customary Institution, Non-Governmental Organizations, and Higher Education Institutions.
3. Further provisions regarding PPT are regulated by Regent Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Article 3

Physical Violence as referred to in Article 2 letter a is caused by acts that result in pain, injury, serious injury or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or cause death.

REGENT OF NORTH BUTON

PROVINCE OF SOUTHEAST SULAWESI

REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH BUTON REGENCY NUMBER S OF 2022

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE WITH THE BLESSING OF ALMIGHTY GOD

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 9

Obligations and responsibilities in the implementation of Protection for Women and Children victims of violence are the shared responsibility of:
a. Regional Government;
b. society; and
c. family and parents.

Article 17

Forms of prevention of violence against women and children carried out by PPT, can be implemented through:
a. Socialization activities of laws and regulations to the community related to the protection of Women's and Children's rights; and  b. Training of PPT members related to the implementation of their duties in preventing violence against Women and Children.

CHAPTER VIl

REPORTING

Article 25

1. PPT reports the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence to the Regent.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph ( 1) shall be submitted in writing, including: a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and d. performance.
3. Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2), shall be carried out at least once every 3 (three) months.

Article 7

Exploitation as referred to in Article 2 letter e is caused by: -8-
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial; and/or
c. any form of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

Article 20

1. In carrying out service duties to Women and Children victims of violence, PPT coordinates with Sub-district PPT.
2. The mechanism for implementing duties as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be organized according to Standard Operating Procedures which are further regulated by Regent Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Article 13

3. Further provisions regarding PPT are regulated by Regent Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Article 27

( 1) The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, customary institutions or non-governmental organizations and universities that implement protection for women and children victims of violence.

2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

c. any form of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:  1. Region is North Buton Regency.

2. Regional Government is the Government of North Buton Regency.  3. Regent is the Regent of North Buton.
4-

4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of North Buton Regency.
5. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
6. Woman is a person who has female genitalia, can experience menstruation, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and includes persons who are legally recognized as Women.
7. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including children in the womb who become victims of violence as well as children in conflict with the law.
8. Violence is any act against a person that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
9. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
10. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
11. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, serious injury or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
12. Psychological Violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feeling of helplessness or severe psychological suffering to a person.
13. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of forced sexual intercourse, sexual abuse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural and/or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
5-

14. Exploitation is an action with or without the consent of the victim which includes but is not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
15. Victim is a woman and child who experiences physical suffering, psychological suffering, sexual suffering, either directly or indirectly resulting from acts of violence.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
18. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by Professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
21. Repatriation is an effort to return women and children victims of violence to the family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.
22. Rehabilitation is recovery from disturbances to physical, psychological, and social conditions so that they can carry out their roles again properly both in the family and in society.
23. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with the family, community, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
24. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
6-

25. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, Safe House, Child Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter, etc.
26. Minimum Service Standards hereinafter abbreviated as SPM is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.
27. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children victims of violence.
28. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Letter a What is meant by "fast" is immediate action taken without complications or simplified procedures. What is meant by "safe" is a guarantee of service protection that feels comfortable, undisturbed, and served in a friendly manner, with respect and appreciation.

What is meant by "empathy" is action that respects, honors, loves, befriends, and makes happy with the aim of pleasing and comforting the victim's heart.

Letter b What is meant by "guarantee of confidentiality" is an effort to guarantee certainty for victims that their identity, medical treatment and legal handling will not be disseminated.
-22- Letter c What is meant by "easily accessible" is the provision of services and assistance for all people regardless of their social status, so that such services are affordable for the underprivileged or relatively sufficient for the privileged.

Letter d What is meant by "not charged" is that service and assistance activities carried out by PPT are not charged to victims.

1. In order to provide services and protection to Women and Children from violence, the Regional Government establishes PPT as an integrated service center for Women and Children victims of violence.
2. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1), consists of elements from the Health Office, Education Office, Youth and Sports Office, Social Office, Cooperatives, SMEs and Manpower Office, Industry and Trade Office, Population and Civil Registration Office, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Office, Community and Village Empowerment Office, Civil Service Police Unit, Regional General Hospital, Police Resort, Kulisusu Palace Customary Institution, Non-Governmental Organizations, and Higher Education Institutions.
3. Further provisions regarding PPT are regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 27

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.

11. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, serious injury or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.

I. GENERAL

Women and children are groups vulnerable to experiencing violence. All forms of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity, therefore legal protection is needed to protect their dignity and honor and to guarantee their right to life in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination.

This view is based on Article 280 paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "Every person has the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under their control, and has the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to protect women and children victims of violence through implementing protection policies for women and children victims of violence applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of service facilities for victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking to create cooperation and coordination in victim recovery efforts.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for Women and Children Victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.

The implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence is carried out based on the principles of respect for human rights, -19- justice, non-discrimination and victim protection. The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to a) prevent violence against women and children; b) eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; c) protect and provide a sense of security for women and children; d) provide services to women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; and e) facilitate and mediate household disputes to realize the integrity of harmonious and prosperous households.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of services, assistance, guidance, supervision, reporting and funding for women and children victims of violence in North Buton Regency.

Article 13

1. In order to provide services and protection to Women and Children from violence, the Regional Government establishes PPT as an integrated service center for Women and Children victims of violence.
2. PPT as referred to in paragraph (1), consists of elements from the Health Office, Education Office, Youth and Sports Office, Social Office, Cooperatives, SMEs and Manpower Office, Industry and Trade Office, Population and Civil Registration Office, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Office, Community and Village Empowerment Office, Civil Service Police Unit, Regional General Hospital, Police Resort, Kulisusu Palace Customary Institution, Non-Governmental Organizations, and Higher Education Institutions.
3. Further provisions regarding PPT are regulated by Regent Regulation.
